description: Pinned upstream source for the native PTY artifact pi-agents ships. build.mjs verifies every field here fail-closed; nothing is resolved at build time and nothing is fetched at install time.

license.note: Upstream publishes no license file: the pinned npm tarball has none at any depth, its Cargo.toml declares no license key, the repository listing at api.github.com/repos/replit/ruspty/contents/ (HTTP 200) contains none, and LICENSE at main, at v3.7.1 and through the GitHub license API all answer 404. The only licence statement is the package.json "license": "MIT" field recorded here. No third-party licence text is reproduced for it, because inventing a copyright holder line would be worse than recording the absence. THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md records that absence as a release blocker and carries the texts every other upstream in this artifact does publish.

platform.note: One artifact, one platform. The crate links glibc, libgcc_s, libm and the loader, so the shipped binary runs on linux-x64 glibc only; musl, arm64 and non-Linux hosts have no artifact and the mechanism refuses them by name rather than loading something that cannot work.
